results.reviewCriterion: Identifies signed office note, not cover sheet.

turn.question: What document is missing?
turn.error: I couldn’t complete that answer. Your message is saved—please try again.

limitations: Expected-source recall and mechanical citation checks are automated. Supported-answer, abstention, hallucination, usefulness and semantic consistency require review of the actual retained output; no fixture is live quality evidence.
stopped: A live turn failed; retained for diagnosis before further paid calls.

metrics.costScope: Includes reported corpus/query preparation and turn generation/embedding usage in this run. Cached query vectors were charged when first prepared. Missing provider usage is unknown, not zero.
